sentences.text: Quebec used a global budget as its primary funding approach for hospitals.
Quebec also used population-based and policy-based methods as secondary funding approaches.
The Comité Bédard recommended a budgeting method for Quebec hospitals based on DRGs and performance, with adjustments to be made for teaching hospitals.

The Comité Bédard also recommended that the Quebec Department of Health build on the work of the Canadian Institute for Health Information (CIHI) rather than attempting to develop its own database on case-mix groups.
In May 1992, the Government of Quebec announced a plan for the rationalization of social and health expenditures for 1992-93.
The Government of Quebec has not provided the Crees with the funding required to operate the new hospital at Chisasibi.

answer.text: Quebec used a global budget as its primary funding approach for hospitals. Quebec also used population-based and policy-based methods as secondary funding approaches. The Comité Bédard recommended a budgeting method for Quebec hospitals based on DRGs and performance, with adjustments to be made for teaching hospitals. The Comité Bédard also recommended that the Quebec Department of Health build on the work of the Canadian Institute for Health Information (CIHI) rather than attempting to develop its own database on case-mix groups. In May 1992, the Government of Quebec announced a plan for the rationalization of social and health expenditures for 1992-93. The Government of Quebec has not provided the Crees with the funding required to operate the new hospital at Chisasibi.
